figure: Figure 4 (v7: v6 content in the sciplot clean theme, mmd-ahd/scientific-figure-skill, with the nature-figure grafts of DESIGN_V7.md; K-Dense skill v1.4 screen)

destination.publisher_rules: PENDING VERIFICATION against the live C&S Guide for Authors; screened only against the skill's dated Elsevier snapshot

outputs.format: PDF (vector, Type 42 / CID TrueType Arial, opaque white, RGB)

transformations: analysis/analyze.py -> analysis/outputs/stats.json (round4.blocklist: Wilson CIs; Mantel-Haenszel risk difference with Sato variance)
fig4/scripts/derive_fig4.py -> fig4/derived_numbers.json (Tranco rank ranges of the two samples; also the entry and re-check records read by Fig 1 and the graphical abstract)

fig4/scripts/make_fig4_panels.py (drawing only; every drawn value -- cell counts k and n, dots, CI ends, diamonds -- registered as a mark in fig4_numbers.csv and checked by scripts/trace_fig4.py; the panels print only axis ticks)
fig4/scripts/make_caption_fig4.py (the caption carries every value; registry caption_fig4_numbers.csv)
uncertainty: a, b left: Wilson 95% CIs of a share (stores are the unit); b right: Mantel-Haenszel difference pooled over the two region defaults, Sato variance. Every CI is an uncapped line in the colour of its mark. No bootstrap (no seed needed).
missing_data: Stores whose CMP wrote 'marketing: yes' are excluded from both panels by design (caption); the reference group is main-sample banner stores without a readable declaration. Nothing lies outside an axis.
note: No automated report here certifies accessibility or journal compliance (skill guardrail).
